name: nico-apple-mcp
description: Apple MCP server for Calendar, Notes, and Contacts on macOS

scripts.build:swift: mkdir -p src/helpers/NicoAppleMCPCalendarHelper.app/Contents/MacOS src/helpers/NicoAppleMCPCalendarHelper.app/Contents/Resources && swiftc -O src/helpers/nico-apple-cal.swift -o src/helpers/NicoAppleMCPCalendarHelper.app/Contents/MacOS/nico-apple-cal && cp src/helpers/nico-apple-cal.Info.plist src/helpers/NicoAppleMCPCalendarHelper.app/Contents/Info.plist && cp src/helpers/NicoAppleMCPCalendarHelper.icns src/helpers/NicoAppleMCPCalendarHelper.app/Contents/Resources/NicoAppleMCPCalendarHelper.icns && codesign --force --sign - --options runtime --entitlements src/helpers/nico-apple-cal.entitlements src/helpers/NicoAppleMCPCalendarHelper.app
